01

“By the sun and its brightness”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 91:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
By the sun and its brightness [al-Shams: 1], he said: “meaning its light.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا [الشمس: 1] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي ضَوْءَهَا»
Edition record 373856 · p. 732Link to report ↗
02

“and the moon when it follows it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 91:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and the moon when it follows it [al-Shams: 2], meaning: “when it comes after it.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا [الشمس: 2] ، يَعْنِي: «إِذَا تَبِعَهَا»

Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

04

“and the heaven and He who built it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 91:5).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:

الإسناد

وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا [الشمس: 5] " يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل: بَنَى السَّمَاءَ "

05

“and the earth and He who spread it (ṭaḥāhā)”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 91:6).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
and the earth and He who spread it (ṭaḥāhā) [al-Shams: 6], meaning: “and He who spread it (daḥāhā).”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا [الشمس: 6] ، يَعْنِي: «وَمَا دَحَاهَا»

06

“and inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 91:8).

06
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 06

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, he said: Hanzala ibn Abi Hamza narrated to us, from Saʿid ibn Jubayr:
and inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness [al-Shams: 8], he said: “He bound it to wickedness and piety.” Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: “He made known to it misery and happiness.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ: نا حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ:
فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا [الشمس: 8] قَالَ: «أَلْزَمَهَا الْفُجُورَ وَالتَّقْوَى» أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: «عَرَّفَهَا الشَّقَاءَ وَالسَّعَادَةَ»
Edition record 373861 · p. 732Link to report ↗
07

“and he has failed who instills it [with corruption]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 91:10).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and he has failed who instills it [with corruption] [al-Shams: 10], meaning: “he has failed whom God (ﷻ) led astray.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا [الشمس: 10] ، يَعْنِي: «خَابَ مَنْ أَغْوَاهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل»
Edition record 373862 · p. 733Link to report ↗

09

“and He does not fear its consequence”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 91:15).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and He does not fear its consequence [al-Shams: 15], he said: “God does not fear its consequence, that is, He does not fear the retribution of anyone.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا [الشمس: 15] قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا، أَيْ لَا يَخَافُ عِقَابَ أَحَدٍ»
Edition record 373864 · p. 733Link to report ↗
